reproduction_target: Computational AIRR-seq / immunoglobulin-genotyping pipeline for human B-cell antibody repertoire across development: long-read IG locus genotyping (IGenotyper) + assembly SV detection (hifiasm), paired-end AIRR-seq preprocessing (pRESTO), personalized germline database construction (receptor_utils + NCBI makeblastdb), V(D)J assignment (igblastn against personalized DB), clonal/unique-cell assignment (shazam distToNearest + Change-O DefineClones), gene-usage frequency analysis, and guQTL replication by linear regression.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from biorxiv JATS Methods prose (source.xml fetched HTTP 200). NO Data availability and NO Code availability section exists — the only availability text is 'Resource availability', which merely directs requests to the lead contact. No accession numbers (GEO/SRA/ENA/dbGaP/EGA/DDBJ), no repository (GitHub/GitLab/Zenodo/figshare), and no software version anywhere in the paper. All named tools are public third-party software (code axis credited), but every version is floating and no environment capture is claimed, so every computational step caps at NI at stage1. Wet-lab library-prep/sequencing steps counted in W, not verdicted (out of computational-reproduction scope).

steps.label: IGenotyper (ref 22) haplotype-resolved IGH/IGK/IGL locus variant and allele identification from PacBio Sequel IIe long reads — no version
hifiasm (ref 36) assembly generation for structural-variant detection — no version, default/unspecified parameters

pRESTO toolkit (ref 37) paired-end AIRR-seq preprocessing (FilterSeq.py quality -q 20; MaskPrimers.py --start 7/12 --mode cut --barcode; PairSeq.py --2f BARCODE; AlignSets.py muscle --bf BARCODE; BuildConsensus.py --prcons 0.6 --maxerror 0.1 -n 1; AssemblePairs.py align; CollapseSeq.py; SplitSeq.py group --num 2) — detailed params, no version

Personalized germline database construction with receptor_utils + NCBI makeblastdb (make_igblast_ndm, annotate_j for IMGT-gapped V-region and auxiliary J files), separate IGH/IGK/IGL BLAST DBs — no version
igblastn V(D)J assignment against personalized germline DBs (-outfmt 19, -ig_seqtype Ig, -domain_system imgt, -organism human) — params given, no version

Clonal / unique-B-cell assignment: shazam distToNearest Hamming distance + Change-O DefineClones.py (--act set --model ham --norm len --dist 0.05), productive/100%-V-identity filtering — params given, no version
Gene-usage analysis: counting clones (IgM) / unique B cells (IgK, IgL) per V/D/J gene and normalizing to per-donor per-stage frequencies — custom, no tool named, no code shared
guQTL replication: SNP-gene pairs from Rodriguez et al. 2023 (ref 19) tested by linear regression for association with gene usage (replicated if p<0.05) — no package/version named, no code shared

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: NI on all 8/8 computational steps. Every named tool (IGenotyper, hifiasm, pRESTO, receptor_utils, makeblastdb, igblastn, shazam, Change-O DefineClones) is a public third-party program (code axis = 1 for 6 steps) but carries NO version anywhere in the paper (all floating), and no environment lockfile, container, or conda spec is claimed. capture_claim=none, so no step can exceed NI even at stage2; there is nothing to escalate. Two custom analysis steps (gene-usage counting, guQTL linear regression) additionally lack any shared code (code=0). Input raw data (AIRR-seq reads, PacBio long reads) has no accession/data-availability statement, so data axis is 0 for all pipeline-entry steps.
